home.intro: We're a tabletop RPG club running D&D, Delta Green, and more. Browse our Game Masters, check the log of every session we've played, and join us at the table.

about.title: About Us
about.body: We're a group of friends who get together to play tabletop RPGs. This site tracks who's run and played what, so we can look back on the campaigns we've shared.

telegramApp.openFromBot: Open this from the club's Telegram bot to see your stats.
telegramApp.title: Hi, {{name}}!
telegramApp.noRatingsYet: You haven't rated any sessions yet — use /rate in the chat!
telegramApp.feedbackAdventureHelp: How much did you like or dislike the game's concept, plot, world-building, characters, and everything else around your character?
telegramApp.feedbackTableHelp: How comfortable or uncomfortable was it playing with the other players — did the group click, or was the session a struggle?
telegramApp.feedbackGmHelp: In your opinion, did the GM run the session well? How good or bad was their performance?
telegramApp.feedbackSelfHelp: How satisfied are you with your own play — your roleplaying, decision-making, and so on? Did you do your role justice, or could you have done better?
telegramApp.feedbackTextHelp: You can write detailed feedback here if you'd like, but it's optional. This will be sent to the GM anonymously — unless you check the box below, in which case the GM will see who sent it.
telegramApp.feedbackRevealLabel: Let the GM see that this feedback is from me
telegramApp.feedbackThanksBody: Your feedback has been sent to the GM.
telegramApp.feedbackNotEligible: Since you haven't rated this session yet, you can't leave extended feedback.
